name: Kerala (Kochi & Munnar)
tagline: Backwater conventions, tea estate retreats & wellness summits
intro: Grand luxury convention centres in Kochi combined with tranquil tea-estate boutique resorts in Munnar for balanced offsites.
access: Flights from Delhi to Kochi, roughly three and a half hours.
highlights: Backwater and hill-station properties suit slower, reflective formats — strategy offsites and leadership programmes rather than high-energy conferences.
Houseboat and plantation activities give a team-building day that does not feel like a corporate exercise.
Pairs a working session in Kochi with a resort stay nearby, so a single trip covers meetings and reward.
planning_note: The monsoon runs roughly June to August. It is genuinely beautiful then and far cheaper, but outdoor sessions become a gamble.
